name: @readme/mobile
description: 리드미 iOS·Android 앱. 배포된 웹(apps/web)을 띄우는 Capacitor 껍데기

scripts.build:ios: cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/App/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.build:android: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
